description: Corrected numerical features, event-window overlap flags and outcomes from the November 6, 2026 study; no raw prices, filing text or excerpts.

source.provenance: Derived from the existing SEC/Yahoo source cache after correcting disclosure extraction; this fixture begins after feature construction and cannot verify collection or extraction.

limits: Historical sample used during development, not an untouched holdout or a pre-registered study.
This numerical replay does not reconstruct raw source collection, text extraction, original release timestamps, or a point-in-time company universe.
Correction and selection comparisons use the same observations as the original reference, not independent replication.
All-company peer relationships are assumptions. Observed concurrent disclosure flags only cover filings present in the six-company source cache.
Empirical residual intervals have no distribution-free coverage guarantee; bootstrap intervals do not correct for study selection or remaining between-block dependence.
